title: Unbiasedness of the uniform cube density
statement: For every natural number $n$, the density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ obtained by pushing forward the uniform distribution on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ under the identity map has every nonconstant Fourier coefficient equal to zero; equivalently, it is biased with bias $0$.
hypotheses_covered: the map is the identity on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$
the Fourier coefficient is considered at every nonzero vector
